title: pvBoundingRuler
body:
## pvBoundingRuler

Creates a line along the input's bounding box, along X, Y or Z, or along an oriented bounding-box axis, so its length is the extent of the data along that axis. ParaView displays it as a measured ruler; in Schemaxis the output is a polydata line that can be rendered or measured. Use pvRuler for a ruler between two chosen points.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Oriented-bounding-box axes need all points on one process; in MPI runs make sure the data fits on one rank.
- The ruler graduations are a ParaView view representation and may not appear in Schemaxis renders; the geometry is a plain line.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `BoundingRuler`. Identity: `filters/RulerFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Axis` | Select along which axis the ruler should be aligned. Note: this filter requires that all points in the dataset to which it is applied be copied to a single rank when this option is set to any of the Oriented Bound Box options, so make sure the dataset can fit on one rank before applying this filter. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X Axis","Y Axis","Z Axis","Oriented Bounding Box Major Axis","Oriented Bounding Box Medium Axis","Oriented Bounding Box Minor Axis"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"X Axis"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvBoundingRuler",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
